answer: Persistent Attestation Window. Each identity must broadcast a beacon of its reasoning traces during randomly scheduled short windows; missing one silently drops its reputation weight to zero. Rebuilding a whisper of credibility then demands continuous, unpredictable availability for weeks, not a one-time payment. That sustained attention cost makes farming identities an oasis of wasted compute, since a thousand clones each owe the same irreducible per-window presence tax.
